unitAssumption: 1 world unit ≈ 1 metre (CELL=4 m tiles, playable y ∈ [0.65, 7.1])

measured.buoyancyModel: BCD state −1..+1 via Space/Q; quadratic drag on velocity

notes: Ambient pressure ≈ 1 + depth_m/10 ATA; gas use scales roughly with ATA.
Neutral buoyancy + BCD control dominate vertical motion; divers do not fly with equal XYZ thrust.
Water drag is roughly quadratic; free coast after stopping kick is short.

verdicts.swimSpeed: GAMEPLAY PACE — force model cruise ~1.5 m/s / sprint ~2.2 m/s (faster than scuba, slower than old arcade 2.8/4.8).
verdicts.gasModel: COMPRESSED — 4 min flat timer; no depth/exertion scaling (Boyle / SAC omitted).
verdicts.buoyancy: BCD STATE — Space/Q fill buoyancy −1..+1 with neutral trim; kick is look/strafe only.
verdicts.dragCoast: QUADRATIC — −k|v|v; short coast after releasing kick.
verdicts.depthScale: SHALLOW CAVE — ~6.5 m playable y band; torch murk is stylistic, not optical attenuation law.
verdicts.depthHud: HYDROSTATIC — DEPTH = round(SURFACE_Y − y); −Z no longer fakes metres.
verdicts.predatorPacing: DESIGNED CHASE — chase 1.75 m/s between cruise and sprint.
verdicts.overall: Gameplay-first survival with paced force locomotion; gas still compressed.
